program: function esc(s){return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/"/g,'"').replace(/'/g,''');}var cardWidth=190,gap=15,startX=20,topY=20,cardHeight=200;var groups=evidence.map(function(d,i){var x=startX+i*(cardWidth+gap);var y=topY;var id=esc(d.id);var label=esc(d.label);var variable=esc(d.variable);var val=esc(String(d.value));var unit=d.unit?esc(d.unit):'Unit not supplied';return '<g data-record-id="'+id+'"><rect x="'+x+'" y="'+y+'" width="'+cardWidth+'" height="'+cardHeight+'" rx="8" ry="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1"/><rect x="'+x+'" y="'+y+'" width="'+cardWidth+'" height="32" rx="8" ry="8" fill="#0284c7" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="1"/><text x="'+(x+10)+'" y="'+(y+21)+'" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">'+label+'</text><text x="'+(x+10)+'" y="'+(y+55)+'" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#475569">'+variable+'</text><text x="'+(x+10)+'" y="'+(y+85)+'" font-size="11" fill="#0f172a">'+val+'</text><text x="'+(x+10)+'" y="'+(y+160)+'" font-size="11" fill="#64748b">'+unit+'</text></g>';}).join('');return '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 240">'+groups+'</svg>';
